physics.source: identical to 7H-D data/fixed_physics.json (read-only): T=300 K, NA=ND=1e17 cm^-3 fully ionized, DEVSIM 2.11.0 SetSiliconParameters, taun=taup=1e-8 s (production setup), constant mobility, SRH only
physics.junction: J1: x<0 -> -NA, x>0 -> +ND, no node on x=0 (asserted). J0 (diagnostic, 1D only): x==0 -> 0

solver.acceptance: info=True: converged == True AND final device relative update < relative_error. abs 1e30 for DD is never used as evidence of convergence.

runs.stop_condition: a run that exceeds 3600 s wall time, raises MemoryError or crashes is recorded as NOT_COMPLETED for that level; no retry with other settings; convergence analysis then uses the completed levels only

reference.truth: 1D J1 at h=0.00125 um is the reference, not declared exact
reference.interpolation: per side (x<0 / x>0 nodes only, contacts included), local 4-point Lagrange (cubic) on the finer solution; applied to psi, ln n, ln p
reference.U_ref_potential_V: max over 1D J1 h=0.0025 nodes of |psi_0.0025 - I[psi_0.00125]| (equilibrium Poisson state)
reference.U_ref_logc: same for max(|ln n diff|, |ln p diff|) at the 0 V DD state
reference.richardson: observed order p from (0.005,0.0025,0.00125) and (0.01,0.005,0.0025); stable iff both in [0.5,4] and |p1-p2| <= 0.25; then the extrapolated J is reported as a supplement only

layer_A_same_h.pair: M2(h) D0 vs 1D J1(h), node by node at identical x

metrics: e_logc = Linf max(|ln n - ref|,|ln p - ref|) at 0 V
yvar_psi = max over exact-x columns with >=2 nodes of psi spread (0 V)
e_Epeak = |max edge |ElectricField| - ref| / ref (equilibrium Poisson; ref = 1D finest)
layer_B_convergence.decreasing_iff: strictly decreasing over >= 3 consecutive executed h levels ending at the finest executed level
layer_B_convergence.at_floor_iff: metric <= floor at every executed level (counts as pass)

layer_C_finest.current: e_I(V) <= max(5 * U_ref_current(V), 0.02) at every bias; current-based approval only if the reference current is converged

equilibrium_checks.positivity: n > 0, p > 0, finite, every node, every recorded bias
equilibrium_checks.quasi_fermi: max |phi - median(phi)| <= 1e-6 V for phi_n and phi_p at 0 V

contact_current_consistency: M3 D0 and D1 at +0.10 V: |I_api(ECE,left) - sum_{edges with exactly one left-contact node} (+-) ElectronCurrent * couple_used| <= 1e-10 * |I_api| + 1e-30 A/cm

hypotheses.H1: CONFIRMED iff J0 stripe width / h is the same constant at every h (pre-solve, 1D) AND 1D |J_J0(h) - J_J1(h)|/|J_J1(h)| strictly decreases over all 5 h at every recorded bias; EXCLUDED iff that difference does not decrease at any bias; else INCONCLUSIVE
hypotheses.H2: CONFIRMED iff for every bias and every consecutive h pair the level-to-level current change of J1 is <= that of J0; EXCLUDED iff J0's is smaller at every pair and bias; else INCONCLUSIVE
hypotheses.H3: CONFIRMED iff M1 D0 and M2 D0 both: layer B decreasing-or-at-floor for e_psi, e_logc, yvar_psi, e_I(all V), e_Epeak; layer C potential and current pass; reference current converged; all equilibrium checks pass; EXCLUDED iff either fails layer C at the finest level with stagnation (e(finest)/e(previous) >= 0.8); else INCONCLUSIVE
hypotheses.H4: CONFIRMED iff M3 D0 at the finest level fails layer C (potential or current) or has yvar_psi > max(5*U_ref_potential,1e-6 V), AND that failing metric stagnates (e(finest)/e(previous) >= 0.8); EXCLUDED iff M3 D0 meets every H3 condition; else INCONCLUSIVE
hypotheses.H5: CONFIRMED iff M3 D1 meets every H3 condition AND 0 negative signed couples, 0 negative signed node volumes, every solve accepted, contact-current consistency passes; EXCLUDED iff M3 D1 fails layer C at the finest level with stagnation; else INCONCLUSIVE

verdicts.C: H4 CONFIRMED (never from one coarse grid)
verdicts.E: reference current not converged (U_ref_current > 0.01 at any bias)
verdicts.F: any of M1/M2 D0 without decreasing errors over 3 levels in e_psi or e_I
